note: P2C: class-specific per-patient rates at operating target D (held-out patients; thresholds and hyper-parameters chosen on training patients), row 0 = observed, rows 1.. = 2000 paired patient-bootstrap draws (rv8 pdraws, RandomState(0)); repeat-averaged as ex_e9_frontier.rates. sens / fpr = share of progressor / non-progressor patients ever flagged; nsp, nsn = samples sequenced per progressor / non-progressor patient; nfp, nfn = flagged endoscopies per patient; nep, nen = pre-event endoscopies per patient; pyn = non-progressor person-years per patient. <rule>_or_g53 = rule OR pathologist grade IND/LGD or p53 aberrant (union flags; never-flagged = de-escalation eligible); <rule>_not_g53 = endoscopies flagged by the rule but not by grade/p53 (incremental work-ups); l53 = LGD or p53 aberrant (g53 score >= 2); <rule>_or_l53 = rule OR l53; ml_final / final = check applied to ml_memcert / memcert (E9 construction); seq_all = max L-LATE of every sample, threshold only; seq_all_mem = same with EW memory
